title: Canonical quote wire format
description: Normalized quote as distributed by market-data-gateway (S1) to all downstream consumers (S2, S3, S8). Defined in CONVENTIONS.md §4; serialized by mdg.models.quote_to_wire. One object per JSON line in the streaming (chunked) distribution; the same dict also appears in JSON array/list responses.

v.description: Wire format version (integer, not a string).

act.description: Action: N=new level, M=modify, D=delete, E=execute, B=bidding tick, O=offering tick.

px.description: Price (float; prices are the one place floats are allowed on the wire).

q.description: Data-quality tag assigned by the gateway's quality monitor.

vt.description: Venue timestamp, int64 nanoseconds since Unix epoch.

rt.description: Receive timestamp at the gateway, int64 ns since Unix epoch. rt >= vt.

nl.description: Gateway normalization latency (rt - vt), int64 ns.
